raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "jointly own"
  role subject "Ana Ferreira and Joost de Wit and Kalinda Singh"
  role object "40% of Tellmark Holdings"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "own"
    role subject ?who
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?who equal "Ana Ferreira"

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "own"
    role subject ?who
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?who equal "Joost de Wit"

@q3 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "own"
    role subject ?who
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?who equal "Kalinda Singh"
